title: DashboardCharts
description: GET /api/dashboard/charts (feature 014): the chart tables for the requested keys, in the order asked. Each item has the shape of `ChartSeries` in dashboard_indicators.v2, which stays frozen; this schema only defines the list around it. A chart the data cannot support is `no_data` with the reason in `summary_params.reason`, never an empty or zero-filled series; a chart that failed is `error` on its own and never stops the others. A role without cost access receives no money column and no value history.

items.description: One value per column; money and decimals travel as strings
